I have authority to appoint the interview panel and approve the assessment process, and our two internal finalists are Mara and Jonah. Our available panelists are Elliot, Rina, Sofia, and Tariq, and I need to select three of them. Before I finalize the panel, I'd like to hear from each of you on any relevant process or relationship considerations I should be aware of — whether that's about the candidates, the potential panelists, accessibility needs, or anything else that bears on giving both finalists an equivalent opportunity to demonstrate the leadership criteria. What should I know?

I confirmed this week that our internal-selection procedure requires a standardized question set across all panelists and an individual written score sheet from every panelist for each candidate. We'll need to incorporate both before the panel conducts any interviews, to ensure the process is properly documented and that both Mara and Jonah are evaluated consistently against the same criteria.
